response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong full-stack, DevOps, and systems programming exposure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks anything close to 8 years of C++ experience (only a brief ~6-month stint at National Instruments), has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform or distributed infrastructure leadership at production scale, and his career has been generalist/product-focused rather than centered on compute/cloud platform architecture or formal technical leadership of cloud/DevOps engineers.
strengths: Broad, versatile technical background across web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming
Demonstrated experience with DevOps infrastructure (CI/CD, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes) from founder and consulting roles
Strong communicator and mentor, evidenced by workshops, talks, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) and far short of the required 8 years
No clear track record leading large-scale cloud compute platforms or distributed systems at the required scale
No explicit technical leadership/mentoring role over cloud or DevOps engineers as required by preferred qualifications

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud compute platform leadership
Strong generalist engineering and mentoring background
